svg.title: Van positions routed by PartitionKey into four partitions and read by two consumer groups
svg.desc: Producers for van-07, van-12 and van-21 set the PartitionKey, and Event Hubs hashes it to choose the partition, so in this example every van-07 position lands in partition 1 in order: 07-1, 07-2, 07-3. van-12 lands in partition 2 and van-21 in partition 3. Positions without a key go to partitions 0, 1, 2 and 3 in round-robin order. The ops-console consumer group and an example reporting group each keep a cursor in every partition and read the same logs at different speeds: reporting has read every partition to the end, and ops-console is one event behind in each.

g.text: Event Hubs hashes the PartitionKey, so every van-07 position lands in the same partition, in order
Positions without a key go to the four partitions in round-robin order
Each consumer group keeps its own cursor in every partition
reporting and ops-console both read every position, each at its own pace
Order holds only within one partition: all van-07 positions sit in one log, in arrival order
Each consumer group reads the full stream at its own pace
